When `@AllArgsConstructor` adds a constructor whose two parameters (e.g. `Date`, `Integer`) also accept `null`, javac reports "reference to Failure is ambiguous" for exactly two non-primitive fields (arity differs with 1 or 3+ fields, so those compile).

**Change** (in both javac and eclipse handlers, `src/core/lombok/{javac,eclipse}/handlers/HandleStandardException.java`):
- No-arg constructor now calls `this((String) null, (Throwable) null)`
- Message-only constructor now calls `this(message, (Throwable) null)`
